video_script: Who is the best Lumbering Pal in Palworld one point zero? It's Celesdir Noct, with level eight Lumbering. Both Celesdir Pals keep your wood storage full, so your builds never stop. The best alternative is Celesdir, with level seven Lumbering. Tip: condense your workers to four stars to raise every work level by one. Who does Lumbering at your base? Comment below!
